item.text:
The script failed because `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` is blank. No sourcemaps were uploaded.

Open Paseo Settings → Plugins → project-env actions menu → Project environment, edit this repository, and press **Test** to see why the variable failed to load.

The script is also a stub marked “fake: no network,” so it won’t upload sourcemaps even with authentication.
